basic_info.description: Residence #735 offers a sophisticated 1BR/1BA retreat in the heart of South Beach, designed for modern city living. Bright and airy, the open living and dining area connects to a private balcony - your personal spot for coffee, cocktails, or simply unwinding. The sleek chef's kitchen boasts Studio Becker cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and Cambria stone countertops, while the spacious bedroom includes a generous closet and room for a home office setup. Additional thoughtful upgrades custom lighting, hardwood floors, and built-in storage systems create both style and function. The spa-style bathroom invites relaxation with a soaking tub, and in-unit laundry plus a deeded, parking space (valued at approx. $50K) adds everyday convenience.  Residents at The Palms enjoy premier amenities including 24/7 concierge and security, a fitness and yoga center, business and conference rooms, a private theater, and resident lounge. With unbeatable access to Muni, Whole Foods, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and the city's top restaurants, this home offers the ultimate blend of comfort, convenience, and vibrant urban lifestyle.
